step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture displays two integration paths into Salesforce: a batch path on top and a real-time streaming path on the bottom. Expedia Group sends source data into an initial S3 bucket. Data flows through EC2 and Glue for transformation into CSV format stored in a secondary S3 bucket, then ingested into Salesforce. On the streaming path, real-time events pass from ECS to Aurora, through Lambda to SQS, and finally up to Salesforce.
